_schema.description: NYC DOE SHSAT Practice Test A — Math section (50 questions). Kept fully separate from the type_X_Y bank; DO NOT sample these into daily prep panels yet.

question_types.mc_multi: Multiple choice A-F, N correct answers ('select the TWO correct answers')
question_types.grid_in: Numeric text input (may also carry an inline figure/diagram)
question_types.dropdown: One or more inline dropdowns embedded in a walkthrough

fields.question: prompt text (multi-line ok; math typeset simply — e.g. x/1 = 0.125/125, x = 0.001)
fields.n_correct: for mc_multi: how many correct choices are expected (e.g. 2)
fields.correct: for mc: single letter string; for mc_multi: array of letters; blank until solutions loaded
fields.grid_answer: for grid_in: numeric answer as string (blank until solutions loaded)
fields.dropdowns: for dropdown: [{label, choices[], answer_index}] — one per blank in the prompt
fields.exhibit_image_path: optional path to a supporting figure image (relative to web/public/)

_schema.type_id: left null for now; will map to the 41-major-type system in a later pass
_schema.solution: left null for now; will be filled with DOE-provided solutions when supplied

questions.question: In a scale diagram, 0.125 inch represents 125 feet. How many inches represent 1 foot?
A car is traveling 55 miles per hour, and 1 mile = 5,280 feet. Which of the following calculations would give the car's speed in **feet per second**?
For what value of w is 4w = 2w − 8?

A survey asked students what pets they have. Based on the results, the following statements are all true:

• 20 students have cats.
• 23 students have dogs.
• 3 students have both dogs and cats.
• 5 students have no dogs or cats.

How many students were surveyed?
The sum of the numbers x, y, and z is 50. The ratio of x to y is 1:4, and the ratio of y to z is 4:5. What is the value of y?

In a certain school, course grades range from 0 to 100. Adrianna took 4 courses and her mean course grade was 90. Roberto took 5 courses. If both students have the same sum of course grades, what was Roberto's mean?

Liam and Kevin each collect stamps. Liam has twice as many stamps as Kevin. Liam gives 8 of his stamps to Kevin. Liam now has 12 more stamps than Kevin.

How many stamps did Liam start with?

Select the correct answer from each drop-down to complete the sentences.

An equation that relates the number of stamps originally in Liam's and Kevin's collections is L = [DROPDOWN_1] K.

After Liam gives 8 stamps to Kevin, the equation becomes L − 8 = [DROPDOWN_2].

By solving the equation, it can be determined that Liam started with [DROPDOWN_3] stamps.
